system_thesis_interpretation: V3 is a deliberately non-agentic prerequisite to the paper architecture, not a reduced implementation of Dream-LoRA-Think. It preserves the later thesis only as an explicitly inactive reference: ordinary public action/outcome lives, later-outcome-grounded local claims, deterministic SLEEP compilation, identical text/graph/LoRA content, bounded recurrent THINK reconstruction, held-out actions, an explicit graph primary baseline, and LoRA credited only for transport/access. The active v3 estimand is narrower: in a closed finite role-alignment family, does persistent descriptor alignment make top-action identity point-identified while independent source alignments remain exactly uninformative after target-local calibration, and do the registered twin, action-cost, conjunctive-retention, and bridge relations have the stated symbolic geometry? The change adopts the v2 rework lineage by deleting the empirical 128-seed renderer and every nuisance byte; using the literal 96-element factorized alignment domain; replacing a shared controller node with four positive pure-function projections; treating twins only as authentic-content counterfactuals; naming CONJ as conjunctive retention; adding BRIDGE as a symbolic old/new causal join; removing codecs and MDL; and constraining any green result to C01 symbolic-kernel eligibility. It contains no lifetime, experience collector, environment, action execution, learned representation, memory organ, model, tokenizer, DREAM, SLEEP, reader, LoRA, GPU, benchmark, promotion, or scientific-claim mechanism. RETAIN_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL means only that an exhaustive implementation matched these registered symbolic invariants and may motivate submission of a new proposal; it is not paper evidence.
graph_delta_interpretation: Applying the deltas removes all seven v2 principals and eleven v2 edges and leaves exactly five active v3 nodes connected by exactly nine active edges. The active node set is SKN01_AUTHORITY, SKN02_ALIGNMENT_ENUMERATOR, SKN03_REGIME_POSTERIOR_PROJECTIONS, SKN04_TWIN_COST_BRIDGE_CHECKER, and SKN05_REPORT_VALIDATOR. Every active edge endpoint is in that set. A topological order is SKN01, SKN02, then SKN03 and SKN04 in either order, then SKN05: SKN01 sends immutable verified constants to each downstream node; SKN02 sends the canonical domain to SKN03 and SKN04 and only count/histogram aggregates to SKN05; SKN03 and SKN04 send only registered aggregates and closed pass summaries to SKN05. There is no edge out of SKN05 and no cycle, feedback edge, report-to-input edge, undeclared external endpoint, or path to a rendered/model stage. SKN03 is one graph principal but four information-isolated sub-stages. LOCAL receives only c,g; MOTIF_SCHEMA only graph,c,g; RANDOM_SOURCE only graph0,graph1,c,g; and ORACLE only pi_t,g, in addition to public immutable contract/domain constants. Each output is derived only inside its own projection and every other projection and the report are forbidden from receiving its per-input chosen pair or support table. This positive projection construction, together with the ban on filesystem, environment, cache, RNG, imports, globals, shared objects, debug and cross-projection references, is the intended v3 answer to the v2 joint-view leak. It is a specification to be enforced by SK08 and later independent review, not a capability already created by this proposal. SKN05 is terminal and may consume only registered aggregates, authority/audit bindings, and boolean/closed receipt summaries; individual alignments, graphs, answers, successful plans, paths, tracebacks, timestamps, host metadata, and free-form debug never cross to it. Static schema validity proves structural closure only; actual source closure and absence of ambient channels remain implementation-review obligations.
loop_delta_interpretation: All four v2 loops are removed: there is no rendered 128-seed CPU instrument, dormant known-good/common-deck model gate, DREAM/SLEEP/LoRA growth study, or on-policy flywheel. The sole proposed active loop, SKL01_EXACT_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL, can start only after an exact future human ratification and fail-closed verification of the approved intake, bound bytes, exact scope, implementation source, and test hashes. It then derives the 96-element alignment domain once; invokes each of the four projections under separately constructed positive inputs; exhaustively checks calibration classes, RANDOM factorization, MOTIF persistence, tau twins, costs, conjunction, and bridge necessity; and terminates at the report validator. It writes only one in-memory canonical report return value ending in one LF, has no retry, learning, recurrence, life, environment, or promotion cycle, and permits no report byte to become a later input. Missing or stale authority, unauthorized scope, malformed evidence, exception, nondeterminism, resource exhaustion, missing receipt, or test-infrastructure failure has REWORK precedence and supplies no partial evidence. A mechanically complete falsification yields REJECT. Exactly ten passes yield RETAIN_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL. Every verdict is terminal and non-authorizing. The acceptance-test required_before labels are one-way safety gates for hypothetical later work; they do not grant GPU, model, benchmark, promotion, or claim authority, all of which remain forbidden and would require a new predecessor-bound deliberation and human decision.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claim ladder is aggressively non-transitive. C01 is narrowed to the statement that a mechanically complete exhaustive implementation matched the symbolic registry, backed by all SK01-SK10 receipts, exact byte bindings, report validation, fresh independent implementation review, and a separate human decision for any successor. C02 through C07 are retired from v3: there is no representation/action-use result, development, prospective learned schema generalization, compression/MDL, parametric transport, or on-policy flywheel result. C08 is narrowed so that TWIN supports only authentic life-specific semantic-content dependence, CONJ only conjunctive retention, and BRIDGE only a symbolic old/new dependency. None attributes effects to DREAM, SLEEP, a reader, retrieval, memory, model, LoRA, development, compression, usability, efficiency, or paper relevance. Every claim delta has headline_eligible=false. The exact RANDOM value 1/4 and MOTIF value 1 are properties of the declared finite information kernel, not learned-system evidence. REJECT does not select a fallback, and RETAIN does not promote. Any rendered benchmark, learned baseline, common-deck model study, graph/RAG/Bayesian/TMEM-like comparison, native-context cut, LoRA/text transport test, GPU run, or scientific claim requires a separate exact change chain and human authorization.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is structurally exact: 115 unique information items times eight unique stages produces 920 unique cells, with neither missing nor extra information/stage pairs. The eight stages are authority, enumerator, four separately named SKN03 projections, checker, and terminal report validator. Public immutable contract constants are visible everywhere but convey no sampled target. Authority context/scope bindings are confined to SKN01 and SKN05. The five enumerator records are derived in SKN02, visible only to the four projections and checker, and forbidden to authority and report. The eleven runtime arguments are visible only to their named projection. Each projection's numerator, denominator, chosen pair, and complete support-count table, including pair/count children, are derived only in that projection and forbidden to all peers and the report. The eleven per-case twin/cost/bridge values are derived only in SKN04. Only registered aggregate count, histogram, reduced-value, failure-count, cost, receipt, verdict, and audit fields cross or arise at SKN05. The eight named forbidden report fields are forbidden in all 64 corresponding cells. This establishes field-level positive projection isolation rather than relying on a shared ambient context. Declassification is intended to expose only alignment/calibration counts, RANDOM and MOTIF aggregate values, twin failure totals, cost summaries, bridge failure total, ordered boolean receipts with closed observed summaries, and the verdict. The matrix correctly gives LOCAL no source graph, MOTIF_SCHEMA exactly one persistent source graph, RANDOM_SOURCE exactly two independent source graphs, and ORACLE target pi_t only; per-input answers never enter the report. However, visibility closure is only as strong as the nested report grammar: the current bound bytes name allowed aggregate fields and forbid obvious secret-bearing fields but do not fully specify the types, exact values, lengths, and canonical grammar of protocol_id, histogram keys, or each receipt observed summary. Therefore the 115x8 Cartesian product is valid while the claimed byte-level report declassification remains underdetermined pending resolution of D02.
acceptance_test_interpretation: The registry contains exactly ten unique tests in canonical SK01-SK10 order. SK01 measures the closed domain: the literal nested permutation product is 4!*2!*2!=96, and each descriptor graph contains the two intermediate plus two top recipe triples. SK02 measures target-local ambiguity: a fixed CAL leaves the paired raw-role orientation, within-pair raw swaps, and top-role assignment unresolved, for 16 alignments. SK03 measures the RANDOM kernel over the literal independent product: for every calibration and goal the 16 candidates yield four TOP pairs with count four each, best value 1/4, and source independence by integer factorization rather than floating-point mutual information. SK04 measures persistence: source GRAPH contains the target goal's top recipe under the shared alignment, so MOTIF_SCHEMA is a point mass for all 96 alignments and both goals. SK05 measures tau and cost-matched authentic-content change only: tau is an involution, swaps both raw recipe pairs, changes both top raw ingredients and all four graph triples, changes TOP for both goals, and preserves costs 5 and 8. SK06 measures only the algebraic grammar: raw acquisition 2+2 plus craft 1 gives intermediate 5; intermediate 5 plus raw 2 plus craft 1 gives top 8; two independent tops give CONJ 16; adding the final consuming craft gives BRIDGE 17. SK07 is intended to measure connected symbolic necessity exhaustively across 96^2 alignment pairs and four ordered goal pairs: deletion or wrong substitution of either required top product must miss the budget-17 bridge. Its scientific label is appropriately limited, but the substitution domain and operational impossibility predicate are not fully bound, as recorded in A03/D03. SK08 measures both values and information closure: exact signatures, reduced rational outputs, deterministic descriptor-index tie-break, complete sorted supports, values 1/4,1,1/4,1, and absence of every ambient or cross-projection capability. It cannot be satisfied by signature inspection alone; source and negative-reachability audit are essential. SK09 is intended to measure exact 16-key output closure, ordered receipts, rejection of malformed/secret-bearing forms, JCS round-trip, and one trailing LF, but it cannot establish byte identity or declassification until the nested grammar and the relationship between semantic key order and JCS lexicographic serialization are exact. SK10 is the independent whole-tree scope test: it must audit source, imports, CLI, dependencies, dormant schemas/options/hooks, and output-to-input paths and find only the three requested atoms, with renderer/RNG/world/life/agent/model/provider/tokenizer/DREAM/SLEEP/reader/memory/LoRA/weights/GPU/remote/promotion/benchmark/claim capabilities absent rather than unused. Its separately signed tree audit is review evidence outside the symbolic runtime and must not become a report-to-input channel. All ten tests are mandatory after authority; none itself grants implementation, execution, GPU, promotion, or claim authority.
assumptions: change.json and its exact ten context bindings control this interpretation; proposal prose is explanatory where change.json is more specific, and this artifact grants no authority or repair.
The five-node and nine-edge closure refers to the post-delta active v3 graph, not the raw delta arrays, which also contain seven node removals and eleven edge removals from v2.
The four SKN03 stage columns are capability-separated sub-stages of the single SKN03 graph node, so their distinct positive projections do not add undeclared graph principals.

The canonical requested_scope is exactly the sorted three-element list and forbidden_scope is exactly the sorted eight-element list in scope_proposal.json; ratification must equal both lists byte-for-byte and may not infer adjacent authority.

Visibility of immutable contract constants and the complete 96-domain permits posterior enumeration but does not convey a sampled target; target-specific runtime arguments remain exclusive to the named projection.

Pure-function isolation means positive immutable arguments plus no ambient authority, import, global, cache, filesystem, environment, debug, shared object, or cross-projection reference; co-location alone is not accepted as evidence of isolation.

The phrase only output refers to the symbolic runtime return. Independent review records and test fixtures may exist only as separately governed evidence and can never be mounted as runtime or successor input without new authority.

REWORK takes precedence for mechanical invalidity; REJECT is available only after a complete valid run falsifies a scientific invariant; RETAIN_SYMBOLIC_KERNEL requires all ten passes and remains non-promotional.

The current user-directed creation of interpretation_scope.json is treated as explicit authority for this interpretation artifact only and not as ratification or as authority for critique, consensus, implementation, test execution, evidence generation, or any later stage.

ambiguities.question: What exact JSON types, literal values, array ordering, key encodings, bounds, and per-test observed-summary grammars define protocol_id, every histogram entry, every receipt observed field, and every verdict form?
ambiguities.impact: Without a complete nested schema or canonical golden object, SK09 cannot uniquely determine valid bytes and an observed summary can become an answer, path, exception, host, or debug declassification despite the 16 top-level key list.

ambiguities.question: Does the listed 16-key semantic order constrain an in-memory construction only, or is it intended to constrain serialized member order even though RFC-8785/JCS sorts object member names lexicographically?
ambiguities.impact: The listed order begins with protocol_id while canonical JCS bytes begin according to lexicographic property order, so SK09's byte-identical round-trip needs one controlling interpretation.

ambiguities.question: What exact set of substitute component plans/products and what algebraic feasibility predicate are quantified by deleting or substituting either component in SK07?
ambiguities.impact: BRIDGE cost 17 and deletion necessity are clear, but exhaustive substitution failure can depend on implementer-selected wrong products or plan equivalence unless the substitute domain and budget accounting are normatively enumerated.

ambiguities.question: Where do the SK09 canonical fixture hash and SK10 independently signed exact-tree audit live when the runtime has exactly one canonical JSON output, SKN05 cannot write files, and no report byte may feed a later input?
ambiguities.impact: Treating them as external review artifacts preserves runtime closure, but their exact provenance, schema, and permanent output-to-input exclusion must be bound before they can satisfy the named evidence_artifact requirements.

ambiguities.question: How can the required two interpretations, critique, consensus, and human ratification be created when human_boundary.forbidden_before_approval[0] forbids creating or editing any such v3 artifact before approval?
ambiguities.impact: A literal reading prevents the mandatory path to approval and makes the proposed authority transition unreachable, notwithstanding the current one-artifact user instruction.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that the current human boundary is a workable fail-closed approval gate because its first forbidden-before-approval item forbids interpretations, critique, consensus, and ratification themselves, while the decision question requires all four before approval.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The operating contract requires those artifacts to precede human ratification, and architecture_intake can release scope only from a human-authored ratification. Exact enforcement of the current sentence therefore deadlocks the chain rather than merely preventing implementation.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Issue revised exact change bytes whose pre-approval prohibition expressly allows the mandated deliberation artifacts and a human-authored ratification while continuing to forbid architecture implementation, source, tests, evidence, receipts, execution, compute, promotion, and claims. Do not infer this repair from consensus.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree with the proposal's claim that the report is already a closed canonical declassification boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The exact top-level key names and several aggregate shapes are supplied, but protocol_id, histogram key/value domains and ordering, the type and grammar of each test_receipts[].observed value, and a complete nested schema or golden object are absent. The prose ban on hidden/debug content is not mechanically equivalent to a closed grammar. The listed semantic key order also differs from JCS serialized order.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before implementation ratification, bind a strict nested report schema with additionalProperties=false at every object level, exact primitive domains and array orders, ten test-specific observed-summary schemas, literal protocol/verdict values, JCS conformance vectors, exactly-one-LF bytes, and explicit separation between semantic presentation order and canonical serialized order.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that SK07 is presently an exact exhaustive property test for substitution necessity, although deletion necessity and the cost-17 join are clear.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The bound bytes do not enumerate what counts as a substitute component plan, whether substitutes range over other top goals, other alignments, malformed plans, or all nonidentical products, or how symbolic feasibility is decided without an environment. Different reasonable implementations can test different finite predicates and all claim to follow the prose.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bind the exact substitute-product domain, plan representation/equivalence, consumption rule, budget accounting, and closed feasibility function, together with independently derived case counts and golden failing examples, before SK07 can produce normative evidence.
